title.en: MALACAÑANG PLACING THE PRESIDENTIAL LEGISLATIVE LIAISON OFFICE UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENTIAL ADVISER FOR SPECIAL

text.en:
The Presidential Legislative Liaison Office (PiLO) is hereby placed under
the supervision of the Office of the Presidential Adviser for Special Concerns.

Section 2 of Executive Order No. 344 (dated 09 August 2004), as well as
all orders, rules, regulations and issuances or parts thereof inconsistent with this Executive
Order, is hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9thday of March, in the Year of Our Lord Two
Thousard and Ten.
By the President:
LANDROL. MENDUZA.
Executive Secretary
POMA Hologram # 55464
